props.gloss_en: the heart was perforated to its chamber [-- tereifa]
'to its chamber' means to the small chamber
'to its chamber' means to the large chamber
R' Shimon: [the perforated lung is tereifa only] when it is perforated to the bronchi
Rav: [R' Shimon means] until it is perforated to the large bronchus
here it teaches 'to its chamber' -- what is it to me a large chamber, what a small one: either
the aorta: Rav -- [tereifa when perforated] by any amount
Rav: [the aorta is the vessel in] the fat upon the sides
(entertained) 'the sides' in Rav's words means the animal's sides
rather: upon the sides of the lung
there are three ducts: one goes to the heart, one to the lung, one to the liver
the lung's [duct] is as the lung
the liver's [duct] is as the liver
the heart's [duct] -- [that is the one over which] they dispute
(reversed) the lung's [duct] is as the liver
(reversed) the liver's [duct] is as the lung
Shmuel: if Abba [Rav] said so, he knows nothing at all of tereifot

supports.gloss_en: מאי תיבעי לך? מי לא תנן: רבי שמעון אומר עד שתינקב לבית הסמפונות, ואמר רב: עד שתינקב לסמפון גדול -- as R' Shimon's bronchi are the large bronchus, so the mishna's chamber is the large one

deflected_by.gloss_en: הכי השתא? התם לבית הסמפונות קתני -- להיכא דשפכי סמפונות כולהו; והכא לבית חללו קתני -- the plural there points to the one bronchus into which all empty; the singular chamber here points to neither
